tagline: STIHL equipment, service and advice for Thames
heroSubheading: We stock, service and repair STIHL equipment for your property and business.
aboutHtml:
Jill and Nic run STIHL SHOP Thames, your local source for STIHL outdoor power equipment. We help you choose the right gear for your property, gardens, or business, then look after it through its life.

We stock a full range of STIHL chainsaws, brushcutters, hedge trimmers and other equipment. If something needs servicing or repairs, we handle it here at the shop. We also stock parts and can advise on which tool will suit your job.

Come in and see us Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, or Saturday mornings. We'll make time to talk through what you need.
servicesIntro: We service and repair STIHL equipment in our Thames workshop and stock replacement parts.
